facts.fact: 四人一致认为这处房子完美。
facts.anchor: The place was perfect, that was what they all said when they found it.

facts.fact: Olivia 的家在 Hertfordshire，学生住处离家乡近二百英里。
facts.anchor: her new student digs, almost two hundred miles away
They moved in on a breezy September afternoon

facts.fact: 抽外卖单分房，Olivia 抽到组合最离谱的一张。
facts.anchor: A menu for an outlet selling pizzas, burgers, kebabs, curries and, get this, mushy peas.

facts.fact: 她挑入口旁大房间，想稳住自己在团体里的位置。
facts.anchor: She hoped that taking the room near the entrance would secure her place in the group.

facts.fact: 她与 Millie、Bella、Abi 三人结成圈子。
facts.anchor: she’d joined up with Millie (intimidatingly blonde and pretty), Bella (posh but with a tattoo of a lizard on her foot), and Abi (practically an influencer)

facts.fact: 别人有时夸她"笑起来很好看"，她认为这是"无威胁"的暗语。
facts.anchor: ‘You have a lovely smile,’ she was sometimes told.

facts.fact: 平淡暑假里她下定决心第二年要大胆。
facts.anchor: Second year would be her year, she decided during an uneventful summer back home.
